title: Read Smarter: Abstracts, Introductions and Main Ideas
objective: Students learn skimming, scanning, close reading, and identifying research purpose.
context: Practice abstract: We asked when bees visit flowers. We watched for ten minutes in the morning and ten in the afternoon. We saw four bees in the morning and nine in the afternoon.

items.prompt: What question did the team ask?
Find the time spent watching and both counts.
items.answer: Ten minutes in each period; four in the morning and nine in the afternoon.
items.hint: Scan for numbers and time words.

items.prompt: Write the main finding in one clear sentence.
items.answer: During this observation, more bees visited in the afternoon.
